Problem Statement:
Write a program that takes a month (as a number) and a year as input and prints the number of days in that month, considering leap years. The program should read the month and year continuously until the user inputs a stop value. You need to handle leap years and invalid inputs. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer n (number of entries).
The next n lines contain two integers each: the month and the year.
The input stops when the user enters -1 -1. 
Output Description:
Print the number of days in the given month for each input. 
Sample Input:
2 2020 -1 -1 
Sample Output:
29
